general_information.name: I THINK IT’S DANIEL… DO YOU MEAN THE FULL NAME INCLUDING THE MIDDLE PART, OR JUST WHAT’S ON THE PAPERWORK?

current_concerns.primary_problems: Mostly contamination fears and a lot of checking stuff. I keep washing my hands and I check the stove and door locks way too much before I leave. It’s been taking up a few hours a day, and I’m often late for work because of it.
current_concerns.goals: I’d like to cut down the checking, get to work on time more reliably, and stop the hand washing from hurting my skin.

past_psychiatric_history.assessment_details: In 2021, by Dr. Harold Blyth, the psychiatrist.
past_psychiatric_history.previous_therapies: Yes, I’ve had cognitive behavioural therapy before.; In 2021.; About 16 sessions, maybe around that.

personal_history.early_childhood: I was born in Lagos and moved to Toronto when I was 7. As a kid I was pretty careful and orderly, I think.
personal_history.adolescence_early_adulthood: I was a strong student, and around age 19 in university is when the checking rituals started.

personal_history.future_goals: I want to manage the rituals well enough to live independently without them.
